title: Feasibility of EnChroma Use in the Emergency Department Setting
brief_summary: This study addresses whether the use of EnChroma products are feasible for use in the emergency department by color vision deficient providers.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age 18-65
* Red-Green color deficiency

Exclusion Criteria:

* Achromatopsia
* Cataracts
* Glaucoma
* Legal blindness
* Macular degeneration
* Retinitis Pigmentosa
